t: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, heard Ammar ibn Yasir (may Allah have mercy on him) comversing with al-Mughirah ibn Shubah and said : Let him alone O Ammar! For he has entered religion only to the extent of his deriving advantage of the world, and he has wilfully involved himself in misgivings in oorder to adopt them as cover for his shortcomings.
